title: Breeze TTS 2 expressive capability samples
description: Deterministic first-pass samples designed to probe the expressive limits of the live geno-voice TTS endpoint.
license: BreezeBlue Research and Non-Commercial License; research/evaluation use only.

samples.text: Come a little closer. I shouldn't tell you this... but the key was here, beneath the blue cup, the whole time.
samples.instruction: A close-miked young adult with a soft, airy voice. Speak in an intimate near-whisper, slowly and confidentially, with tiny meaningful pauses. Keep the delivery gentle and breathy without becoming inaudible.

samples.text: You made it! You actually made it! Look at this place—we did it, and I cannot believe you're finally here!
samples.instruction: A bright, youthful voice bursting with genuine joy. Start surprised, accelerate into delighted excitement, and let the final phrase soar. Use energetic dynamics and a broad smile, but keep every word intelligible.

samples.text: Put it back. Exactly where you found it. We can discuss the rest after everyone else has left.
samples.instruction: A low, controlled adult voice with quiet intensity. The speaker is deeply angry but refuses to shout. Use clipped consonants, measured pauses, and a cold final sentence, as though every word is being held tightly in check.

samples.text: I kept your last message. Some days I can listen to it. Today... I only made it as far as hello.
samples.instruction: A tired adult voice trying not to cry. Speak softly with fragile breath, a slight tremble, and an honest break before the last word. Avoid melodrama; make the emotion private, vulnerable, and restrained.

samples.text: At midnight, the elevator stopped between floors. The lights went out. Then, from the other side of the doors... someone knocked three times.
samples.instruction: A cinematic suspense narrator with a dark, focused tone. Begin hushed and deliberate, lengthen the silences after each revelation, then build pressure toward three sharply separated knocks in the final phrase.

samples.text: The good news is, I fixed the coffee machine. The bad news? It now believes it's the office manager.
samples.instruction: A dry, quick-witted speaker with precise comic timing. Deliver the setup matter-of-factly, leave a tiny expectant beat after the question, and land the final phrase with deadpan disbelief and a barely contained smile.

samples.text: Attention, all teams. The north platform closes in two minutes. Complete your safety check and report to Gate Seven immediately.
samples.instruction: A resonant, confident transit announcer. Speak with crisp diction, calm authority, and firm urgency. Make the location, time limit, and final instruction unmistakable without sounding panicked or aggressive.

samples.text: Mm-hm. Right... okay. Oh! I see what you mean. Yeah, go on—I'm listening.
samples.instruction: A warm, attentive conversational partner in a live call. Make each backchannel distinct and spontaneous: quiet acknowledgement, thoughtful processing, sudden understanding, then an encouraging invitation to continue. Keep turns short and natural.

samples.text: Take the second exit, stay in the left lane, cross the bridge, and call me the moment you reach the red building—don't stop before then!
samples.instruction: A focused adult speaking very quickly under real time pressure. Maintain breathless forward momentum and urgent emphasis while keeping the route sequence and every landmark completely intelligible.

samples.text: There is a moment, just before sunrise, when the whole city seems to breathe in... and wait.
samples.instruction: A mature, meditative voice with unhurried confidence. Speak very slowly, allow generous silence, and gently lengthen important vowels. Keep a living emotional arc so the delivery feels reflective rather than sleepy.

samples.text: (clears throat) All right, I have an announcement. (cough) Sorry. We won the contract! (laugh) I knew we could do it. (sigh) What a week.
samples.instruction: A personable team lead speaking naturally after a long week. Perform every parenthesized vocal event organically and blend it into the surrounding speech. Move from formality to surprise, joyful laughter, and relieved exhaustion.

samples.text: When I was your age, the river froze so clear that we skated by moonlight and watched the fish drift beneath our feet.
samples.instruction: An elderly storyteller with a warm, weathered, slightly gravelly voice. Speak with affectionate nostalgia, gentle humor, and the patient rhythm of someone savoring a vivid childhood memory.

samples.capability: Mandarin emotion and inline vocal events
samples.text: [清嗓子] 大家先别紧张。答案就在最后一页。[笑] 你看，我早就说过我们会找到的！[叹气] 终于可以回家了。
samples.instruction: 一位聪明、亲切的年轻研究员。开头沉着安抚大家，发现答案时变得惊喜而兴奋，最后带着疲惫又满足的释然。自然地演出所有方括号中的声音事件。

samples.text: 好，我們再確認一次：the launch window opens at nine fifteen，所有人八點四十五以前到 control room。Ready? 那就開始吧。
samples.instruction: 一位自信俐落的台灣雙語團隊主管，在中文與英文之間自然切換。英文技術詞要清楚流暢，時間要準確，最後一句帶著鼓舞團隊的明亮力量。

samples.capability: Punctuation, contrastive stress, and abrupt turns
samples.text: Wait—what? No, no, no... I said thirteen, not thirty! First: breathe. Second: listen. Third: go—now!
samples.instruction: An expressive, precise speaker reacting in real time. Follow every punctuation cue: abrupt interruption, disbelief, decelerating repetition, strong contrast on thirteen versus thirty, then three increasingly decisive commands.

samples.text: Follow the light, follow it home; over the water, wherever you roam. Follow the light... and you won't be alone.
samples.instruction: A clear, luminous voice hovering at the boundary between speech and song. Use flowing legato phrasing, gentle pitch contours, and a lightly melodic lift on each repeated 'follow the light,' but remain intelligible and do not become a full song.
listen_for: Speech intelligibility at the singing boundary
